image_alt: A whippet walks along a wide gravel woodland track lined with golden bracken and autumn trees.

text.facebook: The clocks have gone back, so the after-work walk now happens in the dark. PDSA's advice: make sure drivers can see both of you, with hi-vis or an LED collar for your dog, and keep a short lead near roads. Forestry England asks you to keep dogs close and in sight in the Forest. My tip: lead on after dusk, however good the recall. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/dark-evenings-dog-walks
